* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Character: Nute Gunray, Coruscant, R
|strategy=By [mailto:searaptor@mindspring.com Wes Brown]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/nutegunray.html</ref>

Nute is a fantastic card all by himself. His power of 3 and ability to draw battle destiny for himself coupled with his destiny of 3 should earn him a spot in a lot of different decks. His game text, though, is where he really shines. If you thought that [[Daultay Dofine]] made your squads of destroyer droids big and beefy, just take a look at Gunray's text. Not only does he up their forfeit, he more than doubles their destiny draw, which can be a huge boon to a deck of destroyers. Their destiny of 2 is ho-hum compared to the 5 that Nute brings it up to. Add the fact that he can keep some of the Light Side's biggest characters away of a site you definitely want to maintain control of, this Viceroy is easily one of the more solid characters in the set.
